summary: Electra Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. The company develops therapies that targets signal regulatory proteins for the treatment of novel targets for treatment of immune-mediated diseases and cancer. Its lead product candidate is ipsoprubart, that targets signal regulatory protein on the cell surface of myeloid and T cells and depletes pathological immune cells, treatment for secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis and T/NK Cell Malignancies; ELA822, a novel SIRP-specific monoclonal antibody for deplete activated T cells, treatment for T cell mediated immune disorders. Electra Therapeutics, Inc. was incorporated in 2018 and is based in South San Francisco, California.
